pulls.title: 8389111: C2: Use BMI2 BZHI for variable int low-bit masks on x86
pulls.author: aprilivy
pulls.body_excerpt: C2 currently lowers variable `int` low-bit masks of the form: value & ((1 << bits) - 1) to a five-instruction sequence on x86. This change adds a BMI2 matcher rule that uses `BZHI`, reducing it to three instructions. The shift count is explicitly masked with `31` because Java shift distances wrap modulo 32, while `BZHI` treats counts greater than or equal to 32 differently. A scalar JMH throughput benchmark on a Ryzen 9 9950X3D improved from approximately 0.199 ns/op to 0.185 ns/op (6.9%). pulls.title: 8384415: Shenandoah: Hotpatch GC state checks
pulls.author: shipilev
pulls.body_excerpt: This PR implements Shenandoah barrier hotpatching on C2 side, as described in the RFE. In short, we want to dynamically rewrite the "fastpath" GC state checks in nmethods to either `nop`-s (when GC is known idle) or `jump`-s (when GC is known active, and in known state). This greatly improves performance when GC is idle (= only `nop`-s are "executed"), and gives an edge when GC is active as well (no conditional branches, we know we have to go to outline stub). pulls.title: 8370800: Downgrade cant.attach.type.annotations diagnostics to warnings
pulls.author: cushon
pulls.body_excerpt: Hi, please consider this fix for [JDK-8370800: Downgrade cant.attach.type.annotations diagnostics to warnings](https://bugs.openjdk.org/browse/JDK-8370800). As discussed in the, this reduces the compatibility impact of these diagnostics for builds that deliberately omit transitive annotation dependencies, for example if they are only referenced through javadoc `@link` tags, or by frameworks that conditionally load the classes. pulls.title: 8345265: Minor improvements for LTO across all compilers
pulls.author: TheShermanTanker
pulls.body_excerpt: This is a general cleanup and improvement of LTO, as well as a quick fix to remove a workaround in the Makefiles that disabled LTO for g1ParScanThreadState.cpp due to the old poisoning mechanism causing trouble. pulls.title: 8342869: Errors related to unused code on Windows after 8339120 in awt
pulls.author: TheShermanTanker
pulls.body_excerpt: After 8339120, gcc began catching many different instances of unused code in the Windows specific codebase. Some of these seem to be bugs. I've taken the effort to mark out all the relevant globals and locals that trigger the unused warnings and addressed all of them by commenting out the code as appropriate. I am confident that in many cases this simplistic approach of commenting out code does not fix the underlying issue, and the warning actually found a bug that should be fixed. In these instances, I will be aiming to fix these bugs with help from reviewers, so I recommend anyone reviewing
